title: Mac remote: how to lay out the thread screen

a-one-pad.html.title: A. The chat is the trackpad, Settle and Snooze at its foot

b-fill-gap.html.title: B. Same parts, no gap: the trackpad fills the space

c-actions-up.html.title: C. Settle and Snooze in the header, voice mode under the mic

t.text: Mac remote: how to lay out the thread screen

annotations.text: Now: ~120pt of empty space between the message and the trackpad; Settle/Snooze weigh as much as the mic; Stop sits next to talk.

A (recommended): the whole middle is one card, the chat itself, and dragging it scrolls the Mac. Settle | Snooze are a quiet strip at its foot. Stop moves to the 'Working' line, the voice mode takes its slot by the mic.
B: smallest change. Trackpad grows into the gap, buttons go flat. Still two cards that look alike.
C: like A, but Settle/Snooze are icons in the header and the voice mode is a chip under the mic. Cleanest, but the actions are far from the thumb.
